title: launchers-reach-into-no-device
intention: Nothing in launchers reaches into a device: the launchers' ground-loop proof reads the ruled cadence from the liveness tool instead of importing it from the cairn device's ground_loop/__main__, clearing launchers' only encapsulation breach.
why: RULE 1 (encapsulation, Akien 2026-10-01): every component talks to another only through its public interface; a ticket's build lives inside its own component and its proofs and hollow measure only that component. The ruled cadence was spelled inside the cairn device, and launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py:59 reached in for it — one of 80 encapsulation_breaches measured 2026-10-05. Split from 48c0c58a1714 at Akien's word, 2026-10-05: "we said that devices never cross boundaries, that's why we're making these changes. and we said that then we'd only have to run the tests for the changed files and not for all files."
how: launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py line 59 imports CADENCE_S from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness. Depends on c3b14029d6d8. One new proof in launchers/proofs/, already written red.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) no encapsulation_breaches row has a file under launchers/. RED if it fails or launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py stops importing. WRONG INTENT if launchers legitimately needs something only the cairn device's internals can give it (then it is a bus verb, not an import).
watchme: none, because the build_inspector's encapsulation_breaches sieve (cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py) already reds any new reach across a component boundary on every inspection
children: none, because the change is one component's edit plus its one proof, already on disk at launchers/proofs/test_launchers_reach_into_no_device.py

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: in launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py, change line 59 `from cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.__main__ import CADENCE_S as _CADENCE_S  # noqa: E402` to `from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness import CADENCE_S as _CADENCE_S  # noqa: E402`. Nothing else in that file changes.

D2: SETTLED: the proof launchers/proofs/test_launchers_reach_into_no_device.py already stands on disk, written first as this ticket's red-first step and measured red 1/1 at HEAD (2026-10-05: one reach, launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py:59). It is committed at the BUILDME crossing; D1 turns it green and does not edit it.

D3: SETTLED: BUILDME waits for c3b14029d6d8 PROVED. After D1 run the new proof (exit 0) and `python3 -c 'import ast,sys; ast.parse(open("launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py").read())'` plus a module import check `python3 -c "import importlib.util as u; s=u.spec_from_file_location(\'x\', \'launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py\'); m=u.module_from_spec(s)"`; the long live-launch proof itself is not re-run by this ticket. Commit launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py alone naming 13b26f206519. The build file is under proofs/, so the hollow has no eligible build file to revert: under the unvouched-green rule (df05da93) the ticket completes and the operator is notified. No file outside launchers changes.
